$comment: What the library does and will do, each feature tied to the roadmap milestones that deliver it. The feature tables in README.md and docs/website/docs/features.md are generated from this file and docs/features/comparison.json; FeatureTablesTests holds them to it, and holds each status to its milestones' state in docs/roadmap.md. Regenerate with: ADCODICEM_UPDATE_FEATURE_TABLES=1 dotnet test --project tests/AdCodicem.Pdf.Tests -c Release --filter-class '*FeatureTablesTests'

features.name: Opens any PDF without loading it: memory follows what is read, not the size of the file
Opens damaged files — rebuilds a broken index, relocates misplaced objects — and reports every repair as a structured diagnostic
Guards against hostile files, on by default, each lifted by an option so that every valid PDF stays readable
Every standard filter and index form: Flate with predictors, LZW, ASCII85, ASCIIHex, RunLength, cross-reference and object streams, hybrid files
Structural validation with stable, public rule identifiers, a severity, a location and a remedy for each finding
Object-shape rules generated from the PDF Association's Arlington model, version-aware
Revision history, what each signature covers, and changes made after signing, without cryptography
Repair, conservative (incremental) or full rebuild, with a report of what was changed and what was lost
Forward-only streaming writer: full rewrite or incremental update, object and cross-reference streams
PDF 1.7 or PDF 2.0 output, the caller's choice, the version raised and reported when a merge needs it
Deterministic output: the same inputs give the same bytes
Cancellation and progress for every long operation
Insert, remove, reorder, rotate and extract pages, inherited attributes kept
Merge that keeps bookmarks, links, forms, layers, named destinations, attachments and page labels
Attachments and associated files, at document, page and annotation level
Split by bookmark, size, page count or separator page; images to pages without re-encoding
Watermarks, stamps, headers, footers, overlay, N-up and imposition on existing documents
Exhibit stamps ("Pièce n° 12") and Bates numbering, tagged as artifacts so accessible files stay so
Annotations with generated appearances, selective flattening, and optional content (layers)
Legal case files: a piece model, the inventory of exhibits, court-portal presets, e-mail to PDF
HTML and CSS to PDF with a fully managed engine: no browser, no native PDF engine, no external process
Paged media: margin boxes, running headers, page groups, cross-references, tables of contents, footnotes, columns
Contract-grade typography: Unicode line breaking, bidirectional text, hyphenation, OpenType features, per-character font fallback
Batch generation of thousands of documents with compiled templates and shared caches
Resources loaded deny-by-default: no request a template did not earn, no file outside its root
Font subsetting and embedding, WOFF2, an embedded OFL font set
Vector barcodes and payment codes: QR, Data Matrix, GS1-128, PDF417, EAN, SEPA QR, Swiss QR-bill
Fillable forms generated from HTML inputs
Word documents (DOCX) to PDF through the HTML engine
Tagged, accessible PDF: PDF/UA-1
PDF/A-3 and Factur-X / ZUGFeRD: profile-aware embedding, EN 16931 and French rules, a typed invoice model
PDF/A-2 generation; PDF/A-1 to 4 and PDF/UA-1 validation profiles
Conversion of received documents to PDF/A, with a report of what could not be converted
PDF/UA-2, Well-Tagged PDF and PDF/A-4: generation and validation profiles
Text with positions and reading order, tables with a confidence score, images, metadata, attachments
Search with positions; Markdown, JSON, ALTO and hOCR export anchored to pages, for AI pipelines
Comparison of two versions of a document, and field extraction by template
Password encryption and decryption, RC4 to AES-256, permissions; AES-GCM read
AcroForms: fill, flatten, create fields; FDF, XFDF and JSON exchange; batch filling
True redaction, search-and-redact for personal data, and sanitization of hidden content
PAdES signing (B-B, B-T), time stamps, certification, remote signing through the CSC API
Long-term signatures (B-LT, B-LTA) and validation of received signatures against the EU trusted lists
Managed JBIG2, JPEG 2000 and CCITT decoding; an OCR text layer from any engine
Deduplication, recompression, downsampling to a target size, linearization
Pages rendered to images
Print production: PDF/X-4, PDF/VT, CMYK and spot colors
Vertical writing, ruby and MathML
A core with no dependency at all, NuGet or native, and a satellite package for everything that needs one
Native AOT, trimming and browser WebAssembly, verified on every corpus document
A command-line tool, as a dotnet tool and a Native AOT binary
MIT license, no revenue threshold, no per-developer fee
